cluster_stories.title: BYD has built China’s first 4nm driving chip, and it’s putting LiDAR on a $10,000 car
cluster_stories.summary: BYD has unveiled the Xuanji A3, which it calls China’s first automotive-grade 4-nanometre chip for self-driving vehicles. CEO Wang Chuanfu announced the chip at an event at BYD’s Shenzhen headquarters on 28 May, saying it delivers the lowest power consumption per unit of compute in its class, drawing roughly 20% less than comparable semiconductors. cluster_stories.headline: BYD UNVEILS CHINA'S FIRST 4NM DRIVING CHIP

cluster_stories.title: The $6 Billion Chinese Startup Trying to Build Hands for Every Robot
cluster_stories.summary: LinkerBot makes dexterous robotic hands for as little as $600. It wants to become the standard for humanoids and automated factories—and eventually replace human labor altogether.
cluster_stories.headline: $6B Chinese Startup Makes $600 Robot Hands for Humanoids

cluster_stories.title: Zoho-backed Netrasemi launches first AI chip, begins customer trials
cluster_stories.summary: Kerala-based Netrasemi, backed by Zoho, has successfully tested its A2000 AI chip, now production-ready for edge devices. Early trials are underway with customers in surveillance and automotive sectors, targeting a mid-2027 commercial launch. This Indian-designed chip, built on TSMC's 12nm process, is among the first of its kind.
cluster_stories.headline: Zoho-Backed Netrasemi Launches India's First AI Chip

cluster_stories.title: MiniMax Plans China IPO as It Eyes Local Rivals Like DeepSeek
cluster_stories.summary: China’s MiniMax Group Inc. has begun preparations for a domestic initial public offering, according to a regulatory filing, as the fast‑growing artificial intelligence startup challenges local rivals including DeepSeek.
cluster_stories.headline: MINIMAX PREPS CHINA IPO... Takes on DeepSeek Empire

cluster_stories.title: Waymo’s new Ojai robotaxi is cheaper to build, harder to break, and made in China
cluster_stories.summary: Waymo has started offering rides to select passengers in its new Ojai robotaxi, the first vehicle purpose-built for autonomous ride-hailing rather than retrofitted from an existing car. cluster_stories.headline: WAYMO'S NEW OJAI ROBOTAXI... MADE IN CHINA

cluster_stories.title: BYD Debuts China’s Most Advanced EV Chip in Smart-Driving Push
cluster_stories.summary: BYD Co., the world’s largest electric vehicle maker, unveiled a series of technology advances, including what it calls China’s first automotive-grade 4-nanometer chip for self-driving cars.
cluster_stories.headline: BYD Unveils China's First 4nm Self-Driving Car Chip

cluster_stories.title: Here Comes Ojai, Waymo’s New Chinese-Made Robotaxi
cluster_stories.summary: The pale-blue Ojai vehicles will start picking up members of the public in California and Arizona in the next few weeks.

cluster_stories.title: China AI Upstart MiniMax Doubles Sales Ahead of New Model
cluster_stories.summary: MiniMax Group Inc.’s annualized revenue more than doubled over the past two months to at least $300 million, as the Chinese AI upstart prepares to roll out its next flagship model to entice developers and enterprise clients.
cluster_stories.headline: China's MiniMax DOUBLES Sales Ahead of New Model

polls.description: Escalating tensions around AI chip technology between China and the West, involving smuggling, export controls, and China's push for semiconductor independence.
polls.question: Should the US prioritize containing China's AI chip advances or focus on its own innovation?
